result.keyword: Which consultancies in Hobart are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

items.markdown:
When looking for expertise in **business workflow automation** and **Microsoft Power Automate implementation** in Hobart (and Tasmania more broadly), options range from `specialized local digital project groups` to national Microsoft partners with dedicated Tasmanian footprints or remote delivery capabilities.

Because Power Automate heavily leverages the Microsoft 365 stack (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Azure, and Dynamics), organizations active in the region typically approach this through specialized regional IT providers or broader Australian Microsoft partners who deploy locally.[[1]](https://www.sope.com.au/platforms/power-automate)[[2]](https://interintra.com.au/ai-services/automation-workflows/)

### Key Options & Approaches in Hobart

- **Digital Project Management Group (DPMG)** 
	- **Location:** Level 5/24 Davey St, Hobart TAS 7000
	- **Focus:** Based right in the Hobart CBD, they specialize in digital transformation, process optimization, and project management oversight, making them a strong local point of contact for scoping out messy manual workflows before mapping them into tools like Power Automate.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdweFpETjZYelJyGAo)
- **Specialized Australian Microsoft Partners (Remote/Hybrid Delivery for Hobart)** 
	- Many businesses in Hobart partner with specialized national Microsoft ecosystem firms that implement Power Platform and Power Automate remotely or via hybrid local engagement. Providers like **Sope** and **InterIntra** are active Microsoft Solutions Partners specializing explicitly in M365 workflow automation, automated/instant/scheduled cloud flows, and Power Automate Desktop (RPA) for legacy system integration.[[1]](https://interintra.com.au/ai-services/automation-workflows/)[[2]](https://www.sope.com.au/platforms/power-automate)
- **IT & Cloud Consultancies with Tasmanian Reach** 
	- Larger national or regional managed service providers (MSPs) and specialized cloud consultancies (such as Ascenwork) hold Microsoft certifications covering the Power Platform ecosystem (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI). They routinely assist Tasmanian enterprises with end-to-end cloud transitions and automated approval routing.[[1]](https://www.ascenwork.com/microsoft-software/powerapps-application-development-company-in-tasmania-australia/)

### What to Look For in a Power Automate Consultant

When vetting a partner for your specific automation project, ensure they cover:

- **Error Handling & Monitoring:** Building robust notification and failure alert systems so that "silent failures" in background flows don't halt critical operations.[[1]](https://www.sope.com.au/platforms/power-automate)
- **Hybrid Automation (Cloud + Desktop):** Capability to handle both cloud flows (for modern APIs and M365 apps) and Power Automate Desktop (RPA) if you rely on older, legacy on-premise software without APIs.[[1]](https://www.sope.com.au/platforms/power-automate)
- **Licensing Optimization:** Helping you maximize your existing Microsoft 365 tier rather than forcing unnecessary premium per-user license upgrades where possible.

To help narrow down the best fit, could you share:

- What **core business systems or line-of-business software** you are trying to connect (e.g., SharePoint, Xero, Salesforce, or legacy local databases)?
- Whether you need **local face-to-face consulting** in Hobart or are comfortable with a **hybrid/remote Australian Microsoft partner**?
